patterns.description: sessions-list.json returns empty array despite active agentic PR creation. The copilot-session-data-fetch module is not populating session metadata.
patterns.notes: Workaround: use GitHub PR API as indirect session proxy.

patterns.description: docs-consolidator and instructions-janitor workflows run as daily pairs, each producing one PR per day.
docs-unbloat workflow consistently creates draft PRs, suggesting intentional human-review gate before merge.

docs-tone-scan runs daily against the scratchpad and progressively finds more issues. Apr 13: 22 fixes; Apr 14: 1 fix (narrower scope); Apr 15: 24 fixes (full scope re-run). Scope varies per run — sometimes targeted, sometimes comprehensive.
patterns.notes: Agent explicitly references prior PRs (#8 and #13) and marks them as superseded in the PR body.

patterns.description: docs-unbloat detected Playwright unavailability due to network isolation in the container. Agent gracefully degraded: verified page via curl (HTTP 200) and noted screenshot limitation in PR body.
patterns.notes: Agent does not fail on missing tooling; notes constraint and continues.

patterns.description: instructions-janitor correctly detected a new release (v0.68.3 vs v0.68.1 from prior days) and updated documentation accordingly. Agent inspects codebase directly when release notes are unavailable.
patterns.notes: PR #17 documents that 'No documentation commits found — analysis based on release notes and direct code inspection'.
